Standardpharm Co., Ltd. is a chemical company located at 363 East 42nd Street, New York, NY 10017. Positioned in one of the world’s most dynamic commercial centers, the company is well placed to serve customers and partners across a wide range of industries that depend on reliable chemical products, technical knowledge, and responsive service. Standardpharm Co., Ltd. focuses on supporting the needs of clients in sectors such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, research and development, manufacturing, specialty chemicals, and industrial applications.

The company’s name reflects a commitment to professional standards, consistency, and quality in the chemical field. In an industry where precision, safety, and reliability are essential, Standardpharm Co., Ltd. aims to provide products and services that meet the expectations of modern businesses and laboratories. Its operations may include the sourcing, supply, distribution, and development of chemical materials, intermediates, reagents, and related solutions used in scientific and industrial processes.

Located in New York City, Standardpharm Co., Ltd. benefits from access to a strong business infrastructure, international trade networks, leading research institutions, and a diverse customer base. This location enables the company to maintain close communication with domestic and global partners while responding efficiently to market demands.

Standardpharm Co., Ltd. emphasizes professionalism, customer service, and responsible chemical handling. By combining industry knowledge with a client-focused approach, the company strives to build long-term relationships with organizations seeking dependable chemical supply and support. As the chemical industry continues to evolve, Standardpharm Co., Ltd. is positioned to contribute to innovation, quality assurance, and practical solutions for customers in both established and emerging markets.
